relevance_note: Case series of four children with TNFAIP3 variants: "We describe four unrelated patients evaluated at a single tertiary center, each carrying a distinct TNFAIP3 mutation".
method_note: Read the whole paper (no supplementary section in the Markdown) and built the JSON with a short Python script in scratch; every value was typed from my reading, no table was transcribed by script. Labels: the paper calls its four patients "A"-"D" (Table 1 'Patient' column), "Case 1"-"Case 4" and "Patient A"-"Patient D"; I used "Patient A".."Patient D" throughout. is_proband is null for the four patients (not called proband/index case; case series). Relatives in scope: affected relatives (paternal and maternal aunts of A, father/paternal grandfather/paternal great-grandmother and the brother with oral ulcers of B, maternal aunt of C who died of lupus) and the tested-negative parents of D. Left out: A's unaffected brother, A's sister with neurodevelopmental delay, B's unaffected mother and other brother, C's two unaffected sisters, D's brother with anxiety and epilepsy (no HA20-type feature, untested). Previously published people with individual-level facts in the Discussion get rows: ref (15, 16) patient (p.Pro247Leu, male), ref (2, 12, 22) patient (p.Arg271*, female, oral ulcers and uveitis), ref (24) patient (p.Trp168*, HA20 and DLBCL; the sentence 'as found in the father of patient B (24)' may mean this is B's father, not merged), ref (26) patient (p.Q379*, male). Not given rows: the mother and grandmother of the ref (26) patient (only a Behcet's diagnosis), the patients with breast marginal zone lymphomas (25) and other group mentions. Variant type: only A's variant is named as missense; 'Three out of four patients had non-sense mutations' names no one, so B, C, D variant type is 'not reported'. Pathogenicity 'pathogenic' comes from sentences naming the exact protein variant (p.Trp168*, p.Arg271*, p.Q379*). B's inheritance is 'inherited paternal' from 'Her father has HA20 of the same genetic variant'. The father of B's variant string is the string printed for B, tied to him by 'of the same genetic variant'. Normal findings recorded as excluded abnormalities as worded: B's normal chest x-ray and electrocardiogram; D's normal sinus and pulmonary CT (nothing more specific excluded). Numeric labs without a stated interpretation (D's CRP of 60.9 mg/L; A's Smith IgG 23.1 units, negative a year later) were not recorded as features or checklist items. A's ANA '1:160' was recorded as observed autoantibody (titre reported, 'positive' not written). A's 'negative for uveitis and retinal vasculitis' excludes those two features but leaves the broader checklist item 'uveitis or other ocular inflammation' not reported. B's 'without clear celiac disease or inflammatory bowel disease' recorded as excluded with the hedge in severity_or_detail. Father of B's 'aphthous ulcers' not mapped to the oral-ulcers checklist item (site not stated). No contradictions found.
